title: Characterizations of inexact proximal operators
summary: Proximal operators are now ubiquitous in non-smooth optimization. Since their introduction in the seminal work of Moreau, many papers have shown their effectiveness on a wide variety of problems, culminating in their use to construct convergent deep learning methods. The characterization of these operators for non-convex penalties was completed recently in [Gribonval et al, A characterization of proximity operators, 2020].
